sn22.103:1.4: Usually (eg. [sn22.105]()) these four are presented without being suffixed with _-anta_. This suggests _anta_ (“end”) has no great meaning here, but is mostly a verbal variation. The commentary says it means “portion”. Perhaps the image is geometrical, the four sides of a square suggesting it applies universally to this “four-sided world” (_caturanta_).
